A woman, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm passes around grass-like leaves with a sharp familiar smell when crushed. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm spends the afternoon with the small tree with mitten-shaped leaves (three shapes), spicy root smell — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. By evening a person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm is thoroughly, educationally sick. "NOT food," they announce to the fire, pale. "My body told me so." The lesson is learned the hard way — and now the whole village knows it.

💡 You see it again in your mind: small tree with mitten-shaped leaves (three shapes), spicy root smell. A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm's words land on the memory like a label. Sassafras. Of course.
The Journal notes it: Sassafras — NOT food. (A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm tested it.)
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.

🍂 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (1 sticks now.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
"Can we talk?" A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Meera about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.

A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Company makes the road shorter.

A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a toad like a war drum, throat swelling. Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir."
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm needs 3 Dandelions. "For tea. For morale. For reasons."
🥩 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm finds the humming in the grass — too far gone. "Not touching that. Nobody should."
🛡️ Deirdre, Kayden, Li, Olivia and Lucas met them at the door — 5 put down. Deirdre, Kayden, Li, Olivia, Lucas are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Deirdre, Li, June and Caleb met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Deirdre didn't come back. Li, June, Caleb are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
🛡️ June, Caleb, Tomas and Elijah met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. June, Caleb, Elijah are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? June just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ June, Caleb, Tomas and Elijah met them at the door — 3 put down. Tomas didn't come back. June, Caleb, Elijah are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nur just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
◈ THE WAR PATH — A moment of respect, from something that rarely respects. On day 79, June put down Loud-Eyes. On day 69, June put down Loud-Eyes.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Big Big and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: armor the village (1 of 4 fighters armored); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
